states.name: Pennsylvania
states.label: Governor expressed interest
states.summary: Shapiro signaled openness to working with lawmakers. A filing and a Senate floor vote would turn that interest into a legislative path.
states.watch: Watch for a new filing, a Senate committee referral and a clear commitment from Shapiro.

states.name: Michigan
states.label: Prior trifecta stalled
states.summary: Michigan considered the compact during its 2023–24 Democratic trifecta and did not enact it. Benson’s position and a House floor vote are key signals.
states.watch: Watch for a new bill, action by House leadership and a public position from Benson.

signals.label: Previous Democratic trifecta did not enact the compact

states.name: Arizona
states.label: Senate leadership support
states.summary: Incoming Senate President Priya Sundareshan said her caucus is prepared to take up the compact. Hobbs’s position is a key open question.
states.watch: Watch for a new filing in either chamber and a public commitment from Hobbs.

signals.label: Incoming Senate president signaled agenda support

states.name: Wisconsin
states.label: Early-session priority
states.summary: Sen. Kelda Roys identified the compact as an early-session priority. Gov.-elect Crowley expressed interest in talks with legislators.
states.watch: Watch for companion bills, early committee notices and Crowley’s position on signing.

signals.label: Public legislative priority and governor-elect interest

states.name: Nevada
states.label: Governor-elect supports joining
states.summary: Ford supports joining. Both chambers passed a bill in 2019 before a veto. The 2027 regular session is the main opportunity before July 2028.
states.watch: Watch for a standalone bill in the 120-day session beginning February 1, 2027. A constitutional amendment has a longer path.

signals.label: One regular legislative session before the cutoff
Both chambers previously passed a standalone bill
